# Agentmate — LLM Integration Guide

AI-native tool service (Backend as Toolset): todos + notes management via REST API or MCP, multi-tenant, scoped API keys.

## Base URL

```
http://localhost:26001
```

## Authentication

Two methods (use one):

1. **API Key** (recommended for agents):
   - Header: `x-api-key: ak_xxxx`
   - Or: `Authorization: Bearer ak_xxxx`

2. **JWT**:
   - Header: `Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`
   - Get token via `POST /auth/login`

### Scopes

API keys can be scoped. Empty scopes = full access.

Available: `todos:r`, `todos:rw`, `notes:r`, `notes:rw`, `manage_keys`

`*:rw` implies `*:r`. JWT users bypass scope checks.

## Response Format

All responses follow:

```json
// Success
{"id": "...", "title": "...", ...}

// List
[{"id": "...", ...}, ...]

// Error
{"error": "error message"}
```

HTTP status codes: 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 500 Internal Error.

## API Endpoints

### Auth (public)

#### POST /auth/register
```json
// Request
{"email": "user@example.com", "password": "password123"}
// Response 201
{"id": "uuid", "email": "user@example.com", "created_at": "RFC3339"}
```

#### POST /auth/login
```json
// Request
{"email": "user@example.com", "password": "password123"}
// Response 200
{"token": "jwt_token_string"}
```

### Auth (authenticated)

#### GET /auth/me
Response: `{"id", "email", "created_at"}`

#### POST /auth/apikeys
```json
// Request
{"name": "my-agent", "scopes": ["todos:rw", "notes:r"]}
// Response 201
{"key": "ak_full_key_string", "api_key": {"id", "name", "prefix", "scopes", "created_at"}}
```

#### GET /auth/apikeys
Response: `[{"id", "name", "prefix", "scopes", "created_at"}, ...]`

#### DELETE /auth/apikeys/:id
Response: `{"ok": true}`

### Todos (authenticated)

#### POST /todos
Scope: `todos:rw`
```json
// Request
{"title": "Buy milk", "description": "", "priority": "high", "due_date": "2025-12-01T00:00:00Z", "tags": ["shopping"]}
// Response 201
{"id", "user_id", "title", "description", "status", "priority", "due_date", "tags", "created_at", "updated_at"}
```

#### GET /todos
Scope: `todos:r`. Response: array of todo objects.

#### GET /todos/search?q=keyword
Scope: `todos:r`. Response: array of matching todos.

#### GET /todos/:id
Scope: `todos:r`. Response: single todo object.

#### PATCH /todos/:id
Scope: `todos:rw`
```json
// Request (all fields optional)
{"title": "new title", "status": "done", "priority": "low", "description": "...", "due_date": "...", "tags": [...]}
// Response 200: updated todo object
```

#### DELETE /todos/:id
Scope: `todos:rw`. Response: `{"ok": true}`

### Notes (authenticated)

#### POST /notes
Scope: `notes:rw`
```json
// Request
{"title": "Meeting notes", "content": "Discussed...", "tags": ["work"]}
// Response 201
{"id", "user_id", "title", "content", "tags", "created_at", "updated_at"}
```

#### GET /notes
Scope: `notes:r`. Response: array of note objects.

#### GET /notes/search?q=keyword
Scope: `notes:r`. Response: array of matching notes.

#### GET /notes/:id
Scope: `notes:r`. Response: single note object.

#### PATCH /notes/:id
Scope: `notes:rw`
```json
// Request (all fields optional)
{"title": "new title", "content": "updated content", "tags": [...]}
// Response 200: updated note object
```

#### DELETE /notes/:id
Scope: `notes:rw`. Response: `{"ok": true}`

## MCP Integration

Transport: stdio. Set env `AGENTMATE_API_KEY=ak_xxxx` to authenticate.

Tools: `todo_create`, `todo_list`, `todo_get`, `todo_delete`, `note_create`, `note_list`, `note_get`, `note_delete`.

Each tool returns JSON text content with the same shape as REST responses.

## Error Codes

| HTTP | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 400 | Invalid request body / missing required fields |
| 401 | Missing or invalid credentials |
| 403 | Insufficient scope for this operation |
| 404 | Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict (e.g. email already exists) |
| 500 | Internal server error |

## Typical AI Agent Workflow

1. **Authenticate** — Set header `x-api-key: ak_xxxx`
2. **Create a todo** — `POST /todos` with `{"title": "Task name"}`
3. **Create a note** — `POST /notes` with `{"title": "Note title", "content": "..."}`
4. **List with filtering** — `GET /todos` (all) or `GET /todos/search?q=keyword`
5. **Search notes** — `GET /notes/search?q=keyword`
6. **Update** — `PATCH /todos/:id` with fields to change
7. **Delete** — `DELETE /todos/:id` or `DELETE /notes/:id`
